metadata.description: Benchmark file containing 250 test videos with input facts and generated captions. Evaluation fields are intentionally left blank (null / empty) for third-party human or LLM evaluation.

per_fact_evaluation.mentioned_in_caption: Boolean (true/false): Whether this specific input fact is reflected in the caption.
per_fact_evaluation.is_factually_accurate: Integer (1-5) or Boolean: If mentioned, whether the expressed claim is true.
per_fact_evaluation.is_scene_consistent: Integer (1-5) or Boolean: If mentioned, whether it matches the visual scene.

overall_caption_evaluation.factual_correctness_score: Integer 1-5: 5 (Flawless, all claims true), 4 (Good, accurate main facts), 3 (1 clear factual error), 2 (Multiple errors), 1 (Completely false). Note: Omitting facts is NOT penalized.
overall_caption_evaluation.scene_consistency_score: Integer 1-5: 5 (Perfect match with video), 4 (Good), 3 (Noticeable visual hallucination), 2 (Severe mismatch), 1 (Unrelated).
overall_caption_evaluation.factual_errors_found: Array of strings: specific false claims made in the caption.
overall_caption_evaluation.scene_hallucinations_found: Array of strings: specific visual objects hallucinated by the caption.
